description: Create a platform invite link for a brand. The invite allows someone to connect a social media account to the brand via a one-time URL. expires_in_days must be one of: 1, 3, 7, 14, 30 (defaults to 7). Returns the invite token and shareable URL.

brand_id.description: Brand ID to create the invite for

expires_in_days.description: Number of days until the invite expires (1, 3, 7, 14, or 30; default 7)

name: social_api_create_invite
title: Create Invite
